data.goal: Forecast annual crop production using historical production, area, and yield data across all crops and seasons

feature_engineering.name: reshape_to_long
feature_engineering.description: Convert wide-format temporal data to long format for time series modeling
feature_engineering.implementation_code:
df = df.melt(id_vars=['Crop', 'Season'], var_name='period', value_name='value')
df[['metric', 'year']] = df['period'].str.extract(r'(\D+)(\d+)')
df = df.pivot_table(index=['Crop', 'Season', 'year'], columns='metric', values='value', aggfunc='first').reset_index()
df['Year'] = df['year'].str[:4].astype(int)

feature_engineering.name: create_lag_features
feature_engineering.description: Create lag features for time series modeling
feature_engineering.implementation_code:
df = df.sort_values(['Crop', 'Season', 'Year'])
df['lag_1'] = df.groupby(['Crop', 'Season'])['Production'].shift(1)
df['lag_2'] = df.groupby(['Crop', 'Season'])['Production'].shift(2)
df['rolling_mean_3'] = df.groupby(['Crop', 'Season'])['Production'].rolling(3).mean().reset_index(level=[0,1], drop=True)
